    ELSE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
       FROM control.authority_envelope e
      WHERE ((e.platform_context_id = root_expiry_recovery_scope.platform_context_id) AND openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND ((openpc.current_privacy_domain_id())::text = ANY (e.privacy_domain_ids)))))
END
